title: Signal-rank liquidity: one decision per signal run (all three books) and liquidity-rank sizing (reversion books)
label: PROVISIONAL -- one era (2023-26), seed 1 weights for the reversion arms, momentum model-free; both designs were motivated by liqsr_decomp.py, which read the liqsr arms' P&L split. Nothing adopted.
why: liqsr_decomp.py (c51f9c08): refused reversion entries re-enter a median 2 bars later in the same signal run and those late entries carry the late-half loss (-4.41 cs_aro, -12.67 all3k); on reversion the refused trades themselves earn (+7.79 / +11.49), so volume rank orders reversion trades but refusing low-rank ones costs money -> size instead.
definition: as preregistration_liqsr.json (history = the pair's previous K traded mask rows, current excluded; pass = quote volume > the 2/3 quantile; fewer than K -> pass). runs: a signal run = consecutive mask rows; every row of a run takes the pass/refuse decision of the run's first row with quote volume > 0 (history unchanged). size: nothing refused; pass -> tag ':liqhi', else ':liqlo'; stake weight = model sizer weight x (1.0 or 0.5) / (0.75 x 1.0 + 0.25 x 0.5) = x1.143 / x0.571
parameter_choice: K and q unchanged from liqsr (no new cut). Hi share 0.75 = the liqsr guard's keep share of control trades (74.7% cs_aro, 73.8% all3k). Weights 1.0 / 0.5 = the existing sizer's ratio (WidthSizerMixin STAKE_WEIGHTS), not fitted; the decomposition's per-trade P&L ratio kept/refused was ~2.3 (cs_aro) and ~3.2 (all3k), i.e. seen.

arms.cs_aro_all3k_liqsz: NNNC_CS_ARO_ALL3K_LIQSZ (same on the all-available book; fillable cap and max_stake still apply)

code: utils/LiquidityGuardMixin.py (runs and size options, stake_weight; utils/tests/test_liquidity_guard.py); SimpleTrigger/SimpleTrigger_BreakoutGbb_MomExit_G24_LiqRun.py; NNNC/NNNC_CS_ARO_{LIQRUN,LIQSZ}.py, NNNC/NNNC_CS_ARO_ALL3K_{LIQRUN,LIQSZ}.py
instrument: all 15 records per arm, each run with its own FT_LIQ_GUARD_DUMP. runs arms: >= 99% of trades' signal candles (row before the open, trade's own fold dump) keep = True; >= 10% of the control's trades' signal candles refused in the same dump; 0 position adds. size arms: 100% of trades tagged ':liqhi' / ':liqlo'; hi share of trades in [0.65, 0.85]; mean tag stake factor in [0.95, 1.05]; >= 99% of trades' tags agree with the dump's keep flag; 0 adds. Both halves have trades. Fail -> that question INCONCLUSIVE, no P&L read
